Dance Dance Revolution - Club Version -.name: Dance Dance Revolution Club Version Dreamcast Edition
Dance Dance Revolution - Club Version -.summary: On February 17, 2000, Konami released a version of Dance Dance Revolution 2ndMix for the Dreamcast console. It features 43 songs, seven of which are hidden and unlockable. The song list includes seven songs from Dance Dance Revolution 3rdMix.

Feet of Fury.name: Feet of Fury
Feet of Fury.summary: Feet of Fury is an unlicensed rhythm action game for the Dreamcast, with the ability to import songs from other dancing games.

Sengoku Turb.name: Sengoku Turb
Sengoku Turb.summary: Sengoku Turb is an action RPG based on a PC-98 shareware game of the same name.
